brief: public String parseToString(File file) throws IOException, TikaException{}
method_comment:
* Parses the given file and returns the extracted text content. *

* To avoid unpredictable excess memory use, the returned string contains * only up to {@link #getMaxStringLength()} first characters extracted * from the input document. Use the {@link #setMaxStringLength(int)} * method to adjust this limitation. * * @param file the file to be parsed * @return extracted text content * @throws IOException if the file can not be read * @throws TikaException if the file can not be parsed * @see #parseToString(Path)
